records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Theo,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Pioneer Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad to have Pioneer Analytics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-08-13) but no invite and no key milestone since; no customer replies after onboarding email [email:5e8d2e2e] or the held call [calendar:78377418]. Engagement exists but has gone quiet for ~6 days with 8 days left, so unaided activation is possible but not likely.

draft.subject: Next step for Pioneer Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week -- good to see your first project up in Wrenfield already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so building that one out with real work is usually what makes everything else click.

If it would help, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work to walk through your next step together?

Best,
Nadia
